unreleased.title: Languages, easier navigation and release notes

sections.title: Added
items: Choose English, Spanish, Czech, Slovak, German, French, Brazilian Portuguese, Indonesian, or Polish on the welcome screen, beside sign-in, or in Settings. Automatic language selection follows your device’s preferences and falls back to English.
Find the latest changes and previous releases in Settings → What’s new. Click the version in the footer to open them directly.
After an update, the footer highlights the new version until you open its release notes.

sections.title: Improved
items: The popup’s branding header scrolls away while the navigation tabs stay visible, leaving more room for content.

sections.title: Fixed
items: On-page player access prompts open Malmark’s permission screen when the browser cannot request access on the watch page, fixing an error in Firefox.

sections.title: Added
items: My list shows your Currently Watching titles, episode progress, and links to MyAnimeList. English titles appear first when available.
Edit custom website selectors in the picker or under Sites, with previews and validation before saving.
On-page prompts help you match an anime or grant access to an embedded player.

sections.title: Improved
items: Opening Profile refreshes your MyAnimeList statistics and keeps saved statistics visible while loading.
Settings lives in the header, and expanding the sidebar preserves your current view.
Unmatched titles try shorter searches while retaining season and part information.
Custom website setup continues after granting permission, and generated selectors use more stable surrounding elements.

sections.title: Compatibility
items: Firefox requires desktop version 142 or later.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Manual and automatic matching can find titles hidden by MyAnimeList’s default search filter, including Magical★Explorer.
